name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
description:
About This Game

Puppeteer: No Strings Attached

Puppeteer is a fast-paced combat game where you control a puppet battling iconic bosses from classic fairy tales. Set in a dramatic theatrical world, each fight is a test of skill and strategy. Face towering adversaries, master your puppet’s abilities, and conquer the stage in a quest to break free from the strings of fate.

Dark Tales Fights in Theatrical World

Immerse yourself in a breathtaking theater-inspired world where every stage comes alive, reimagined villains from classic fairy tales, in epic battles that test your skill and strategy.

Pull the Strings Together — Co-op Mode

Team up with a friend and take on the fairy tale's darkest villains side by side. In co-op mode, two puppets share the stage, combining abilities and coordinating attacks to bring down towering bosses in ways no solo puppeteer could manage alone. Whether you're covering each other's weaknesses or unleashing devastating combo strikes, every battle becomes a performance worth watching.
short_desc: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.
